storeyarms_instructor.text: Waterproofs on, spirits up. Storey Arms is where the main Pen y Fan path begins, and it is nearly all up.
Pen y Fan is 886 metres, the highest peak in southern Britain. The park is Bannau Brycheiniog, after the old Welsh kingdom of Brycheiniog.
It is also Wales's first International Dark Sky Reserve, so on a clear night the stars come out in force.

then.text: Another flask? Leave some for the mountain. Off you go.

else.text: Take a flask, it is hot. I have a shelf of them, and every one has been to the top.

storeyarms_cadet.text: My group is learning to read a map. Mine says we are in the middle of a lake. It is a lovely map, to be fair.
